english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for something that consoles or gives relief from worry or suffering.
This is the all-purpose choice for comfort or solace given to someone.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for emotional comfort or reassurance that dispels worry.
Use this for emotional or psychological relief, such as forgiveness being a comfort to someone’s conscience.

examples.english: Having you with me is already a comfort.
examples.traditional: 有你陪住我，已經係一種安慰。
examples.jyutping: jau5 nei5 pui4 zyu6 ngo5 ji5 ging1 hai6 jat1 zung2 on1 wai3

examples.english: Your words of consolation made me feel better.
examples.traditional: 你句安慰令我個心舒服咗。
examples.jyutping: nei5 geoi3 on1 wai3 ling6 ngo5 go3 sam1 syu1 fuk6 zo2

examples.english: What you said was a real source of reassurance to me.
His willingness to forgive me was a real salve for my conscience.
examples.traditional: 佢肯原諒我，對我個良心真係一種安慰。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hang2 jyun4 loeng6 ngo5 deoi3 ngo5 go3 loeng4 sam1 zan1 hai6 jat1 zung2 on1 wai3
